author: Jeremiah Estrada
title: Woman charged after allegedly stabbing boyfriend to death in Makiki - NewsBreak
text:
By Jeremiah Estrada ,
1 hours ago HONOLULU (Island News) -- A 23-year-old woman who was taken into custody for allegedly stabbing her 46-year-old boyfriend in Makiki area on Friday was charged with murder. Honolulu Police Department detectives learned from their investigation that a 46-year-old man was involved in an argument with his 23-year-old girlfriend, Sinaleen Joseph, on Friday, March 30, 2026. Police said the argument escalated and Joseph allegedly stabbed the him multiple times, in which he died from his injuries. Read full article
